Name: Frozen Yogurt
Author: failsplat
Description:
[size=5][size=3]Note: This mod depends on Artisan Valley, which is not being updated for SDV 1.6. Waiting for the the successor to Artisan Valley to come out for SDV v1.6.[/size][/size]
[size=6]Frozen Yogurt[/size]
Adds a Frozen Yogurt Machine to produce a variety of froyo flavors from Artisan Valley yogurt.

[size=5]Required Mods[/size]
- Producer Framework Mod
- Json Assets
- PPJA Artisan Valley (for Yogurt)

[size=5]Optional Mods (Unlock more flavors!)[/size]
- PPJA Fruits and Veggies
- PPJA More Trees
- PPJA More Recipes
- PPJA Even More Recipes

[size=5]Contents[/size]
Frozen Yogurt Machine! Converts Artisan Valley yogurt into frozen treats!
Chocolate Swirl Machine - Adds a chocolate swirl to frozen desserts! (Planned: standalone version including chocolate-swirl ice creams)
[size=4]Main Flavors:[/size]
All recipes have a Yogurt item, unless otherwise stated.
- Plain Frozen Yogurt (just Yogurt)
- Specific Fruit flavors for: Most base game fruits, Lemon, Lime, Kiwi, Raspberry
- General Fruit Frozen Yogurt (any other Fruit + Yogurt, or any Fruit Yogurt)
- Coffee
- Green Tea
- Chocolate (from PPJA More Recipes)
- Vanilla (from PPJA More Trees)
- Cookies and Cream (Cookies)
- Honey
- Mint (Mint from PPJA Fruits and Veggies)
- Hazelnut (Hazelnut)
- Nut Butter (any item with the "nut_item" or "ph_nut" context tags)
- Pumpkin Pie (Pumpkin Pie + 2 Yogurt, makes 2 portions)
- Cheesecake (from PPJA Even More Recipes)
- Caramel (from PPJA Even More Recipes)
- Ginger
- Taro
[size=4]Chocolate Swirl Flavors:[/size]
Most recipes take in 1 basic froyo flavor from the "Main Flavors", adding chocolate
- Mocha (Coffee)
- Double Chocolate (Chocolate)
- Chocolate Hazelnut
- Chocolate Flavors for: Banana, Blueberry, Cherry, Coconut, Hot Pepper, Orange, Pineapple, Pomegranate, Strawberry, Raspberry
- Chocolate Fruit Swirl (other fruit)
- Mint Chocolate
- Fudge Royal (Vanilla)
- Chocolate Nut Butter
- Chocolate Cookie and Cream
- Chocolate Caramel
- Neapolitan (Fudge Royal, uses Frozen Yogurt Machine)
[size=4]Fantasy Flavor Set:[/size]
- Prismatic (Prismatic Shard, or Magic Rock Candy (makes 4))
- Qi's (Qi Fruit)

[size=5]Installation[/size]
1. [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io/).
2. Download this mod folder.
3. Put the unzipped content packs into `Stardew Valley/Mods` to install them.
4. Run the game using SMAPI.

[size=5]Planned Expansion[/size]
"Normal" Flavors:
[list]
[*]Fruit Combinations, either specific or generic (eg. Mango-Chili, Strawberry-Kiwi, Spicy Fruit) (Planned for v1.7.0)
[*]Maple (Maple Syrup) (Planned for v1.7.0)
[*]Eggnog (Egg + Cinnamon) (Planned for v1.7.0)
[*]Peanut Butter and Chocolate Peanut Butter (Planned for v1.7.0)
[/list]I am planning on splitting off "fantasy" flavors as a submod/expansion in separate folders, so users can decide whether they
want to use them.
"Fantasy" Flavors: (Planned for v1.7.0)
[list]
[*]Void (Void Egg + Eucalyptus Leaves)
[*]Primeval (Dino Egg + Ancient Fruit)
[*]Frost Fairy (Fairy Dust + Crystal Fruit)
[*]Galactic (Solar Essence + Starfruit)
[*]Island Cinder (Cinder Shard + Ginger)
[/list]"Starbrew" Flavors (Planned for v1.8.0)
"Sweet Tooth" Flavors (Planned for v1.9.0)
